observed: Existing Rochester public still shows an Opentrons-labelled enclosed liquid-handling gantry with a dark front frame; the exact model cannot be read confidently.
Manufacturer Flex component figure shows a dark front fascia and status strip, light side panels, transparent windows, a substantial covered gantry, instrument mounts and a front-right touchscreen.
Flex documentation describes 12 deck slots, corner labware clips, sheet-metal and aluminum-extrusion frame construction, illumination strips and a hinged front door.
modelled: Dark fascia/status strip, camera aperture, window edge sections, side carrying recesses and fastener caps.
Covered gantry beam and end bearings, vertical mount rails and local cable-harness detail.
Eight tapered disposable tips at the pre-existing 9 mm spacing and tip target coordinates; deck clips and a 96-position rack.
Eight enabled exterior tip envelopes and mount contacts plus a contact-capable gantry, carriage and head, with a 5 N authored vertical-axis force cap.
Sequencer fixed opaque fascia replaced by real open framing, moving contact-capable front panels, continuous supported runners and open-top stops around the freely supported inert carrier.
A bounded measured dry-touch/retract and loaded-tray open/access/close operation preserves all original joint ranges and free-carrier degrees of freedom.

Separated beam/carriage/head shells with open rectangular Y bearing sleeves, continuous Z guides and moving rear pads; original joint frames and travel retained. Enabled parent-child geometry is checked directly during every measured task step because normal contact filtering omits those pairs.
Source-informed supported left-hinged transparent door with enabled collision surfaces; former meter-valued slider retired and replaced by front_door_hinge in radians.

Authored bench-mounted XYZ fork physically transfers a free inert 96-well-sized plate from external four-pad stage to deck slot 2, releases it, closes/reopens, then retrieves and returns it. No weld switching or pose assignment during the task.
Original gantry XYZ, dry-touch carrier and sequencer task are retained; one static front-center plate prop is replaced by the free loading plate.
inferred: The instrument is a Flex-dimensioned mechanical surrogate, not an identification of the Rochester instrument; the source still may show an older model.
Fastener placement, panel thickness, tip taper and cable-harness geometry are original visual estimates.

Guide sleeves have an authored 0.5 mm clearance; the Z bearing pads retain at least 42 mm guide overlap throughout the 240 mm stroke. These ideal-joint-supported guides are original engineering approximations, not OEM bearing or transmission dynamics.
The tray has an authored 20 N force cap and 12 ms retaining-wall numerical contact response; neither is a measured manufacturer calibration.

The external fork, open guides, receiving pads and left hinge dimensions are authored engineering surrogates, not source-observed Flex gripper hardware. The right display is shifted to clear the hinge sweep.
unresolved: No OEM CAD or verified Rochester device model number is available.
No validated fluid metering, optical sensing or manufacturer calibration model.
Unplanned combinations of the original full joint ranges may collide with the newly physical head; the measured bounded route is not a certification of arbitrary motions.

Machined orientation-head spindle and clamp jaws, fasteners and adjustment knobs follow the articulated specimen carriage.
Blade-holder base, pressure plate and clamp levers; U-shaped red safety guard follows its existing actuator.
Light handwheel with dark perimeter and separate coarse-feed wheel; retained specimen/blade target sites and control interfaces.
inferred: BIOCUT is a representative form reference, not a verified identification of the microtome at Penn.
